description: Recommended NPC injection policy for simulation startup. daily_sim NPCs should receive regular town-life planning and social behavior. investigator_sim NPCs should be active, mobile, and clue-driven, but run with stronger investigation goals and tighter pacing than ordinary residents. limited_sim NPCs should stay mostly scene-bound or constrained. scene_only entries should be instantiated as encounter, evidence, or hazard objects rather than daily autonomous NPCs. cosmic_not_sim entries should be handled by director/event systems instead of normal NPC simulation.

scene_only: Deep One Hybrid (Bearer of the Innsmouth Taint)
cosmic_not_sim: Moon Mirror Guardian, Mother of a Thousand Young in the Mountains (Avatar of Shub-Niggurath)
